errors.message: & can't be used with INTEGER values
errors.hint: & joins text, so at least one side must be a STRING or a CHARACTER.

notes: Wording for E-CHK-OPERAND-TYPE in Edexcel (first version, for review in docs/review/M2.md). (concat variant). EDX-26: & joins strings only; EDX-16 covers a STRING with a non-STRING. Decision D4 in docs/review/M2.md.
